# Heirloom

> Heirloom is a physical video book company that lets customers upload photos and videos to a web-based builder, then ships a rechargeable hardcover book with an integrated HD IPS screen (5", 7", or 10") and speaker that automatically plays the media when the cover is opened. No wifi, app, or technical skill is required by the recipient.

Important notes:

- Heirloom is a physical product company, *not* a software/SaaS product — revenue comes from selling and shipping video books, custom covers, gift boxes, and gift cards
- The builder at make.sendheirloom.com is a web-based media editor (drag-and-drop arrangement, cover design, music selection, preview) — it is not a downloadable app, though an iOS companion app also exists
- Video books are loaded at Heirloom's fulfillment center in Bethesda, MD and shipped pre-loaded, or customers can order blank books and load them via USB
- Founded in 2020 by siblings Ashley and Zack, inspired by sending videos to their 92-year-old Grandma Fran during COVID-19 isolation
- Featured on Today Show, Good Morning America, Forbes, CNN, QVC, Good Housekeeping, USA Today, CNET, and others

## Products

- [5" Video Book](https://sendheirloom.com/): 854x480 HD IPS screen, up to 10 minutes of video or ~200 photos, 256 MB storage, ~1 hour battery, USB-rechargeable, built-in speaker
- [7" Video Book](https://sendheirloom.com/): 1024x600 HD IPS screen, up to 20 minutes, larger speakers, available with premium gift box
- [10" Video Book](https://sendheirloom.com/): Up to 60 minutes of video, largest screen option
- [Custom Printed Covers](https://sendheirloom.com/): Full-color UV-printed front cover; back, spine, and inside cover also available. 5–7 business day production. No minimum quantity
- [Gift Cards](https://order.sendheirloom.com/products/gift-card): Recipient creates their own video book
- [Gift Boxes](https://sendheirloom.com/): Premium packaging for 7" and 10" books

## Use Cases

- [Birthday Video Books](https://sendheirloom.com/send-birthday-video-gift/): Compile birthday messages from family and friends into a physical keepsake
- [Wedding Video Books](https://sendheirloom.com/wedding-video-book/): Preserve wedding videos and photo slideshows in a tangible format
- [Memorial Video Books](https://sendheirloom.com/mail-memorial-video-book/): Commemorate loved ones with video tributes
- [Business Video Books](https://sendheirloom.com/business/): Sales, marketing, branding, real estate, fundraising, and events. B2B customers report 30% higher conversion rates. Bulk orders welcome
- [Photographers & Videographers](https://sendheirloom.com/for-photographers-and-videographers/): Bulk orders for client delivery, with custom covers and direct-ship options
- [Photo Books](https://sendheirloom.com/photobooks/): Photos auto-combined into slideshows (~4 seconds per photo). 10-minute book fits ~150 photos, 20-minute fits ~300

## Builder & Technical

- [Video Book Builder](https://make.sendheirloom.com): Free to try. Upload from computer, phone, Facebook, or Instagram. Drag-and-drop arrangement, cover selection/design, background music (library or custom), inside message, preview
- [Load My Book (for blank books)](https://sendheirloom.com/load-my-book/): Instructions for loading media onto blank video books via USB
- [Local Builder (for reloading)](https://make.sendheirloom.com/local): Update or change media on books you already own
- Supported formats: .mp4, .mov, .jpeg, and all standard Android/iPhone formats
- Optimal resolution: 480p (854x480) for 5" books, 1080p (1024x600) for 7" books
- Vertical and horizontal screen orientations supported — auto-selected based on uploaded media majority, with letterboxing for mixed orientation

## Shipping & Fulfillment

- [Shipping Information](https://sendheirloom.com/shipping/): Standard USPS delivery in 5–7 business days. Expedited 2-day and international shipping available. Fulfillment from Bethesda, MD
- [Returns](https://sendheirloom.com/returns/): Return policy details
- Production: 2–3 days for standard books, 5–7 additional days for custom covers. Books ship same day they are completed
